name: ISTnet
summary: Perth full-service dialup + permanent-connection + hosting ISP (ISTNet, Greenwood, ~1997); defunct (INFORMATION SYSTEMS TECHNOLOGY NETWORK PTY LTD, ACN 009 251 745).

events.details: Defunct. ISTnet-branded site survived to Jun 2012 but the domain showed Red Dirt's RDC Broadband by Apr 2013 — takeover death c. 2012-13 as proposed, not 2002.

refs.label: 18 Jun 2012: still an ISTnet-branded hosting/ISP site (post-takeover management since late 2010-11).
By 8 Apr 2013 the domain served Red Dirt Communications' fixed-wireless 'RDC Broadband' site.
ISTnet's IP blocks (103.6.208.0/22, 203.56.23.0/24) formally passed to Red Dirt on 19 Aug 2015; the original ISTnet company ABN 38 009 251 745 was cancelled 1 J
